news.titleZh: 【学术交流】i‑Microbiome Lab 线上开展学术交流，中国海洋大学刘旭辉硕士作专题报告
news.titleEn: [Academic Exchange] i-Microbiome Lab conducts online academic exchanges. Liu Xuhui, a master's student from Ocean University of China, delivers a special report.

blocks.zh: 近日，西南科技大学智能微生态与生物制造实验室（i‑Microbiome Lab）组织线上学术交流报告会，邀请中国海洋大学刘旭辉硕士作题为《高质量石斑鱼基因组组装和生长关键基因鉴定》的专题报告，实验室全体师生线上线下共同参与本次交流学习。
blocks.en: Recently, the i-Microbiome Lab of Southwest University of Science and Technology organized an online academic exchange seminar, inviting Liu Xuhui, a master's student from Ocean University of China, to deliver a special report titled "High-Quality Genome Assembly of Large-Scale Reef Fish and Identification of Key Genes for Growth". All the teachers and students of the laboratory participated in this exchange and learning session both online and offline.

blocks.zh: 报告伊始，刘旭辉硕士介绍个人教育背景与科研经历。他本科毕业于烟台大学海洋学院水产养殖学专业，硕士就读于中国海洋大学海洋生命学院生物技术与工程专业，师从周茜研教授、陈松林院士；先后在青岛华大基因研究院、北京大学现代农业研究院开展学习工作，熟练掌握基因组组装注释、转录组分析、GWAS 分析以及 AI 辅助生物信息分析等技术，曾荣获硕士研究生文体和社会活动奖学金、研究生学术（实践）创新奖学金。
blocks.en: At the beginning of the report, Master Liu Xuhui introduced his educational background and research experience. He graduated from the School of Oceanography of Yantai University with a bachelor's degree in Aquaculture. He then pursued his master's degree at the College of Marine Life Sciences of Ocean University of China, under the supervision of Professor Zhou Xianyan and Academician Chen Songlin. He has conducted studies and work at Qingdao BGI Institute and Peking University Modern Agriculture Research Institute. He is proficient in technologies such as genome assembly and annotation, transcriptome analysis, GWAS analysis, and AI-assisted bioinformatics analysis. He has received the Master's Student Cultural and Social Activity Scholarship and the Graduate Student Academic (Practical) Innovation Scholarship.

blocks.zh: 报告结束后进入互动研讨环节，实验室师生就基因组组装参数设置、生长性状候选基因筛选、多组学联合分析、AI 在组学数据分析中的实际应用等问题积极提问。刘旭辉硕士结合自身项目实践经验逐一进行细致解答，双方针对水产基因组研究与陆生作物组学研究之间可借鉴互通的技术思路展开充分探讨，线上交流氛围热烈浓厚。
blocks.en: After the report, the interactive discussion session began. The teachers and students from the laboratory actively raised questions regarding issues such as setting of genome assembly parameters, screening of candidate genes for growth traits, combined analysis of multiple omics, and the practical application of AI in omics data analysis. Master Liu Xuhui, based on his own project experience, provided detailed answers to each question. Both sides extensively discussed the technical ideas that could be borrowed and exchanged between aquatic genome research and terrestrial crop omics research. The online communication atmosphere was lively and intense.

blocks.zh: 本次线上学术交流，为实验室师生搭建了跨院校、跨研究方向的学习平台。大家学习到水产动物基因组与关键基因挖掘的完整研究范式，拓宽了多组学、生物信息学与 AI 辅助分析的学术视野，也为课题组后续开展玉米、微生物相关组学研究提供新的思路参考，进一步促进不同研究领域之间的技术借鉴与思想碰撞。
blocks.en: This online academic exchange has provided a cross-institutional and cross-disciplinary learning platform for the teachers and students of the laboratory. Through this event, everyone has learned the complete research paradigm of aquatic animal genomes and the exploration of key genes, broadening the academic horizons of multi-omics, bioinformatics and AI-assisted analysis. It has also provided new ideas and references for the research group to carry out subsequent studies on corn and microbial omics, further promoting the technical borrowing and ideological collision among different research fields.

blocks.zh: 记录人：李杨飞
blocks.en: Recorded by: Li Yangfei

news.titleZh: 【本科生培养】微生物源壳聚糖国创赛项目本科生成员见面会顺利举行
news.titleEn: [Undergraduate cultivation] The meeting of undergraduate members of the microbial source chitosan national innovation competition project was successfully held

blocks.zh: 近日，智能微生态与生物制造实验室（i-Microbiome Lab）微生物源壳聚糖国创赛项目组举行了本科生成员见面会。本次见面会由阎凌翔博士生主持，吸引了来自西南科技大学生命科学与农林学院、医学院等多个学院的24级、25级本科生同学踊跃参加，现场气氛热烈。
blocks.en: Recently, the i-Microbiome Lab's microbial chitosan project team held a meeting with undergraduate students. This meeting was hosted by Dr. Yan Lingxiang, and attracted 24th and 25th grade undergraduate students from the School of Life Sciences and Agriculture and Forestry of Southwest University of Science and Technology and the School of Medicine. The atmosphere was warm.

blocks.zh: 见面会上，同学们首先依次进行了自我介绍，分享了自己的专业背景、兴趣方向以及加入项目的初衷。通过面对面的交流，来自不同年级、不同专业的同学迅速加深了相互了解，为后续跨学科协作奠定了良好基础。
blocks.en: At the meeting, the students first introduced themselves in turn, sharing their professional background, interests and the original intention of joining the project. Through face-to-face exchanges, students from different grades and different majors quickly deepened their mutual understanding and laid a good foundation for subsequent interdisciplinary collaboration.

blocks.zh: 随后，阎凌翔博士生围绕项目背景、发展历程、国创赛参赛要求以及团队具体工作内容进行了系统介绍。他结合微生物源壳聚糖的研究特色与技术路线，详细讲解了项目从菌种筛选、发酵工艺优化到壳聚糖提取纯化及产品应用开发的全链条布局，并鼓励同学们在竞赛实战中提升科研素养与团队协作能力。
blocks.en: Subsequently, Dr. Yan Lingxiang gave a systematic introduction to the background of the project, the development process, the requirements for participation in the National Creation Competition, and the specific work of the team. Combining the research characteristics and technical route of microbial chitosan, he explained in detail the whole chain layout of the project from strain screening and fermentation process optimization to chitosan extraction and purification and product application development, and encouraged students to improve their scientific research literacy and teamwork ability in the competition.

blocks.zh: 实验室负责人梁元可教授也来到见面会与同学们交流。他指出："要用一年时间，做一个让自己大学期间都难忘的事。"这句寄语既点明了参赛备赛的节奏与分量，也道出了实验室以竞赛为载体的育人初心——希望同学们把这一年当作一场踏实而纯粹的科研历练，在真实项目中收获成长、留下属于自己的大学印记。
blocks.en: Professor Liang Yuanke, the head of the laboratory, also came to the meeting to communicate with his classmates. “Take a year to do something that will make your college days memorable,” he said. "This message not only points out the rhythm and weight of the preparation for the competition, but also the original intention of the sportsman in the laboratory who uses the competition as the carrier - I hope that the students will take this year as a solid and pure scientific research experience, harvest and grow in the real project, and leave their own university mark.

blocks.zh: 本次见面会充分体现了实验室对中国国际大学生创新大赛等学科竞赛的高度重视，也展现了i-Microbiome Lab在本科生科研训练与创新能力培养方面的持续投入。实验室希望以竞赛为抓手，引导本科生尽早接触科研前沿、参与真实项目，在"做中学、赛中学"的过程中实现知识、能力与素质的全面提升。
blocks.en: This meeting fully demonstrates the high importance the laboratory attaches to discipline competitions such as the China International University Innovation Competition, and also demonstrates i-Microbiome Lab's continuous investment in undergraduate research training and innovation ability training. The laboratory hopes to take the competition as the starting point, guide undergraduates to contact the frontier of scientific research as soon as possible, participate in real projects, and achieve a comprehensive improvement of knowledge, ability and quality in the process of "doing middle school and competition middle school".

blocks.zh: 记录人：李杨飞
blocks.en: Recorded by: Li Yangfei

news.titleZh: 【科研进展】实验室主持的国家自然科学基金青年项目获批立项
news.titleEn: [Scientific Research Progress] The National Natural Science Foundation Youth Project hosted by the laboratory was approved

blocks.zh: 近日，国家自然科学基金委员会正式公布2026 年度项目评审结果，智能微生态与生物制造实验室（i-Microbiome Lab）梁元可教授主持申报的青年科学基金项目（C 类）成功获批立项，资助经费 30 万元，研究执行期为 2027 年 1 月 1 日至 2029 年 12 月 31 日。
blocks.en: Recently, the National Natural Science Foundation of China officially announced the results of the 2026 annual project review. Professor Liang Yuanke, chairman of the Intelligent Microbiome and Biological Manufacturing Laboratory (i-Microbiome Lab), successfully approved the youth science fund project (category C), with a grant of 300,000 yuan. The research implementation period is from January 1, 2027 to December 31, 2029.

blocks.zh: 本次获批项目围绕实验室主攻方向的关键科学问题开展系统研究，旨在通过多学科交叉手段，深入揭示相关过程的内在机理，并为拓展实验室研究方向提供新思路。项目的实施将进一步丰富实验室在智能微生态与生物制造领域的研究积累，也为推动相关方向的青年人才培养与学科交叉提供重要支撑。
blocks.en: This approved project carries out systematic research on key scientific issues in the main direction of the laboratory. It aims to deeply reveal the internal mechanism of relevant processes through multidisciplinary cross-disciplinary means and provide new ideas for expanding the research direction of the laboratory. The implementation of the project will further enrich the laboratory's research accumulation in the fields of intelligent micro-ecology and biomanufacturing, and also provide important support for promoting the cultivation of young talents in relevant directions and the intersection of disciplines.

blocks.zh: 国家自然科学基金青年科学基金项目（C 类）面向青年科研人员，旨在支持其在起步阶段开展独立、系统的创新性研究。本次项目的成功立项，既是对梁元可教授前期科研积累的肯定，也为实验室下一阶段发展注入了新的动力。
blocks.en: The National Natural Science Foundation Youth Science Fund Program (Category C) is aimed at young researchers to support independent, systematic and innovative research in its infancy. The successful establishment of this project is not only an affirmation of Professor Liang Yuanke's early scientific research accumulation, but also injects new impetus into the next stage of laboratory development.

news.titleZh: 【科研进展】实验室主持的企业技术开发委托项目获批立项
news.titleEn: [Scientific research progress] The entrusted project of enterprise technology development hosted by the laboratory was approved and approved

blocks.zh: 近日，智能微生态与生物制造实验室（i-Microbiome Lab）梁元可教授团队与企业合作申报的"微生物源羧甲基壳聚糖的研发"项目正式获批立项。本项目由梁元可教授指导、阎凌翔博士研究生牵头开展，执行期为 2026 年 8 月至 2029 年 7 月，立项经费 30 万元，所属研究方向为"壳聚糖生物制造（合成生物学）"。
blocks.en: Recently, the "research and development of microbial carboxymethyl chitosan" project declared by Professor Liang Yuanke's team in cooperation with enterprises in the Intelligent Microbiome and Biological Manufacturing Lab (i-Microbiome Lab) was officially approved. This project is led by Professor Liang Yuanke and Dr. Yan Lingxiang graduate students. The implementation period is from August 2026 to July 2029, with a project funding of 300,000 yuan. Its research direction is "chitosan biomanufacturing (synthetic biology)".

blocks.zh: 本项目依托实验室在合成生物学领域的科研积累，与长三角某生物科技企业合作开展微生物源羧甲基壳聚糖的绿色生物制造与产业化关键技术研发，旨在对接化妆品与功能材料等领域的应用需求，构建从菌种设计、发酵优化到下游提取纯化的完整工艺路线。
blocks.en: This project relies on the accumulation of scientific research in the field of synthetic biology in the laboratory, and cooperates with a biotechnology enterprise in the Yangtze River Delta to carry out the research and development of key technologies for the green biomanufacturing and industrialization of microbial carboxymethyl chitosan. It aims to meet the application needs of cosmetics and functional materials, and build a complete process route from strain design, fermentation optimization to downstream extraction and purification.

blocks.zh: 本次项目的顺利立项，是实验室在产学研合作方面迈出的坚实一步。通过本项目的实施，实验室将进一步打通"基础研究—技术开发—产业化应用"的链路，为后续科研成果的转移转化积累宝贵经验。同时，本项目也为阎凌翔等青年研究人员提供了独立牵头横向课题的实战机会，对提升其科研组织与工程转化能力具有重要意义。
blocks.en: The smooth establishment of this project is a solid step for the laboratory in terms of industry-university-research cooperation. Through the implementation of this project, the laboratory will further open up the link of "basic research — technology development — industrial application", and accumulate valuable experience for the transfer and transformation of subsequent scientific research results. At the same time, this project also provides a practical opportunity for Yan Lingxiang and other young researchers to independently lead horizontal projects, which is of great significance to improve their scientific research organization and engineering transformation capabilities.

news.titleZh: 【本科生培养】实验室与2026级本科新生开展线下交流活动
news.titleEn: [Undergraduate training] Offline exchange activities between the laboratory and 2026 undergraduate freshmen

blocks.zh: 9月15日下午，生命科学与农林学院部分2026级本科新生前往智能微生态与生物制造实验室（i-Microbiome Lab）东九B2-22开展线下交流。
blocks.en: On the afternoon of September 15, some 2026 undergraduate freshmen from the School of Life Sciences and Agriculture and Forestry went to the Intelligent Microbiome and Biological Manufacturing Laboratory (i-Microbiome Lab) to conduct offline exchanges at B2-22.

blocks.zh: 交流会上，实验室相关负责人介绍了实验室的基本情况、主要研究方向和近年来的发展状况。内容涵盖根际微生物与植物互作、土壤过程调控、微生物源功能材料生物制造等研究方向，以及实验室在项目立项、平台建设和学科竞赛等方面的进展。此外，还介绍了实验室在人才梯队建设、科研平台拓展、产学研合作等方面的发展规划，并对本科生进入实验室参与科研训练的相关事项作了说明。
blocks.en: At the exchange meeting, the relevant person in charge of the laboratory introduced the basic situation of the laboratory, the main research direction and the development situation in recent years. The content covers research directions such as rhizosphere microbial-plant interactions, soil process regulation, and biomanufacturing of microbial functional materials, as well as the progress of laboratories in project formulation, platform construction, and discipline competitions. In addition, the development plan of the laboratory in terms of talent echelon construction, scientific research platform expansion, industry-university-research cooperation and other aspects were introduced, and the matters related to undergraduate students entering the laboratory to participate in scientific research and training were explained.

blocks.zh: 在提问环节，新生就本科阶段如何进入实验室、参与科研训练需要做哪些准备、如何选择适合自己的研究方向等问题与在场师生进行交流。实验室在读研究生及高年级本科生结合自身经历逐一作答。
blocks.en: In the questioning session, freshmen communicate with the teachers and students on how to enter the laboratory at the undergraduate level, what preparations need to be made to participate in scientific research and training, and how to choose the appropriate research direction for themselves. Graduate students and senior undergraduates in the laboratory answer questions one by one based on their own experiences.

blocks.zh: 本次交流活动面向本科新生开放，是实验室开展本科生科研启蒙、落实"早引导、早进组、早培养"理念的具体举措。实验室将依托现有条件，持续为本科生提供科研训练机会，支持学生在实践中提升专业能力与创新意识。
blocks.en: This exchange activity is open to undergraduate freshmen, and is a concrete measure for the laboratory to carry out undergraduate scientific research enlightenment and implement the concept of "early guidance, early entry into the group, and early training". Relying on existing conditions, the laboratory will continue to provide undergraduate students with opportunities for scientific research and training, and support students to improve their professional competence and innovation awareness in practice.

blocks.zh: 记录人：李杨飞
blocks.en: Recorded by: Li Yangfei

news.titleZh: 【产学研合作】i-Microbiome Lab 赴晟氏绿色自然（四川）生物有限公司调研并开展团建活动
news.titleEn: [Industry-university-research cooperation] i-Microbiome Lab went to Sheng's Green Nature (Sichuan) Biotechnology Co., Ltd. to investigate and carry out group building activities

blocks.zh: 2026年9月16日，西南科技大学智能微生态与生物制造实验室（i-Microbiome Lab）全体成员赴绵阳市北川羌族自治县，对晟氏绿色自然（四川）生物有限公司进行交流访问。本次行程旨在了解生物科技企业的实际发展状况与产业需求，探索校企协同创新与产学研合作的可行路径。
blocks.en: On September 16, 2026, all members of the Intelligent Microbiome and Biological Manufacturing Laboratory (i-Microbiome Lab) of Southwest University of Science and Technology went to Beichuan Qiang Autonomous County, Mianyang City for an exchange visit to Sheng's Green Nature (Sichuan) Biology Co., Ltd. The purpose of this trip is to understand the actual development status and industrial needs of biotechnology enterprises and explore feasible pathways for collaborative innovation and industry-university-research cooperation between schools and enterprises.

blocks.zh: 晟氏绿色自然（四川）生物有限公司（原四川晟氏生物医药有限公司，2025年底完成更名）成立于2021年1月，系晟氏健康科技集团核心成员企业，主要从事功能营养食品、食品添加剂、特色饮料及天然原料类产品的技术开发、生产制造与经营销售。公司现已打通从氨基酸原料、抗衰老因子到成品制剂与保健口服液的全产业链环节，并具备为客户提供 OEM/ODM 定制服务的能力。在生产条件方面，公司建有按 GMP 标准设计的生产车间，配备植物预处理、超临界提取与生物发酵工程等设备，并建立了较为完善的质量管理体系与检验流程。
blocks.en: Sheng's Green Nature (Sichuan) Biotechnology Co., Ltd. (formerly Sichuan Sheng's Biomedical Co., Ltd., renamed at the end of 2025) was established in January 2021 as a core member of Sheng's Health Technology Group. It is mainly engaged in the technical development, manufacturing and sales of functional nutritious foods, food additives, specialty beverages and natural raw material products. The company has now opened up the whole industry chain from amino acid raw materials and anti-aging factors to finished products and health oral solutions, and has the ability to provide customers with OEM/ODM customized services. In terms of production conditions, the company has established a production workshop designed according to GMP standards, equipped with plant pretreatment, supercritical extraction, biological fermentation engineering and other equipment, and has established a relatively complete quality management system and inspection process.

blocks.zh: 访问期间，实验室成员在公司接待人员的引导下，依次参观了生产工厂与科研中心。参观涵盖从原料预处理、萃取纯化到灌装包装的主要生产环节，双方就相关工艺原理、设备选型与研发条件进行了现场交流。科研中心部分则集中展示了企业的技术创新平台与在研方向。
blocks.en: During the visit, under the guidance of the company's reception staff, the laboratory members visited the production plant and the scientific research center in turn. The visit covered the main production links from raw material pretreatment, extraction and purification to filling and packaging, and the two sides had on-site exchanges on relevant process principles, equipment selection and R&D conditions. The research center section focuses on the technology innovation platform and research direction of the enterprise.

blocks.zh: 座谈环节，晟氏生物方面介绍了企业在天然产物高值化利用、功能成分稳态化、工艺降本与标准化等方面的技术需求。梁元可教授及随行团队成员结合 i-Microbiome Lab 在智能微生态与生物制造方向的研究积累，就微生物组资源开发、功能菌株挖掘及生物制造工艺等可能的合作切入点进行了交流，并表达了在产学研协同、技术攻关与人才培养等方面开展合作的意愿。双方一致认为，高校的基础研究能力与企业的工程化、市场化优势具有较强互补性，具备进一步对接的空间。
blocks.en: During the discussion session, Sheng Biotechnology introduced the technical needs of the enterprise in terms of the high-value utilization of natural products, the stabilization of functional ingredients, process cost reduction and standardization. Professor Liang Yuanke and accompanying team members combined with i-Microbiome Lab's research and accumulation in the direction of intelligent microbiology and biomanufacturing, exchanged possible entry points for cooperation in microbiome resource development, functional strain mining and biomanufacturing processes, and expressed their willingness to cooperate in industry-university-research collaboration, technical research and talent training. The two sides agreed that the basic research capabilities of colleges and universities are highly complementary to the engineering and market-oriented advantages of enterprises, and there is room for further docking.

blocks.zh: 访问当日，实验室组织了组建以来的首次全体成员团建活动，赴石椅羌寨开展踏青。此次活动为师生在科研工作之余提供了交流平台，有助于缓解科研压力、增进师生情谊、增强团队凝聚力。
blocks.en: On the day of the visit, the laboratory organized the first group building activity for all members since its establishment, and went to Shichi Qiangzhai to carry out Taqing. This activity provides an exchange platform for teachers and students to work outside of scientific research, helping to alleviate the pressure of scientific research, enhance the friendship between teachers and students, and enhance team cohesion.

blocks.zh: 此次北川之行兼具业务交流与团队建设的双重意义。通过走访晟氏生物，实验室师生增进了对生物科技企业发展阶段与现实需求的了解，为后续校企协同创新与产学研合作奠定了基础；同期开展的团建活动则进一步增强了团队凝聚力与归属感。双方约定保持沟通，推动具体合作方向的进一步落实。
blocks.en: This trip to Beichuan has the dual significance of business exchanges and team building. Through visiting Sheng Biotechnology, laboratory teachers and students have improved their understanding of the development stage and actual needs of biotechnology enterprises, laying the foundation for follow-up school-enterprise collaborative innovation and industry-university-research cooperation; the team building activities carried out during the same period have further enhanced team cohesion and sense of belonging. The two sides agreed to maintain communication and promote the further implementation of specific cooperation directions.

news.titleZh: 【博学论坛】梁元可教授邀请马普所博士生李正洲作客第48期博学讲坛，共话 AI 时代科研工作流
news.titleEn: [Academic Forum] Professor Liang Yuanke invited Ph.D. student Li Zhengzhou of the Mapu Institute as the guest of the 48th Academic Forum to talk about the workflow of scientific research in the AI era

blocks.zh: 2026年9月18日19:00，西南科技大学第48期博学讲坛在东11楼B201/B203举行。本期讲坛由实验室梁元可教授邀请德国马克斯·普朗克研究所博士生李正洲联合报告，欢迎全校师生参加。现场座无虚席，气氛热烈。
blocks.en: At 19:00 on September 18, 2026, the 48th Southwest University of Science and Technology Lecture Forum was held at B201/B203 on the east 11th floor. Professor Liang Yuanke of the laboratory invited Li Zhengzhou, a doctoral student at the Max Planck Institute in Germany, to give a joint report at this forum. The whole university is welcome to participate. There were no empty seats at the scene, and the atmosphere was warm.

blocks.zh: 李正洲为马克斯·普朗克研究所博士二年级在读，硕士阶段主要从事玉米育种研究，博士阶段转向水稻生物信息学与多组学研究，目前主要通过基因组学、转录组学、代谢组学等多组学数据，结合 GWAS、群体遗传学和生物信息学分析，挖掘控制水稻品质形成的关键基因及其遗传机制，参与发表 Nature Plants 综述，并持续开展水稻品质相关遗传与多组学研究。他以《AI 时代的科研工作流与研究生成长经验分享》为题，结合自身从作物育种到多组学研究的科研转型经历，与现场同学分享了 AI 时代的科研工作流搭建与研究生成长体会。
blocks.en: Li Zhengzhou is studying for the second year of his PhD at the Max Planck Institute. At the master's stage, he is mainly engaged in maize breeding research. At the doctoral stage, he has turned to rice bioinformatics and multiomics research. At present, through genomics, transcriptomics, metabolomics and other multiomics data, combined with GWAS, population genetics and bioinformatics analysis, he has excavated the key genes that control the formation of rice quality and their genetic mechanisms, participated in the publication of the Nature Plants review, and continued to carry out research on rice quality-related genetics and multiomics. Taking the title of "Scientific Research Workflow and Postgraduate Growth Experience Sharing in the AI Era", he combined his own experience of scientific research transformation from crop breeding to multi-omics research, and shared with the field students the experience of scientific research workflow construction and postgraduate growth in the AI era.

blocks.zh: 随后，梁元可教授以《工具在变，判断力不变》为题作报告。梁元可博士、教授、博士生导师，任职于西南科技大学生命科学与农林学院，博士毕业于比利时根特大学，先后在瑞士日内瓦大学、德国马普所等顶尖机构从事博士后研究。长期聚焦植物应激响应与再生机制，利用 CRISPR 基因编辑与多组学技术，系统阐明了 ERF 转录因子驱动植物损伤后高效再生的分子通路，并鉴定出全新的紫外光 UV-B 光信号响应和保护代谢物。以第一作者在《Science Advances》等国际顶尖期刊发表多篇论文，其研究为作物抗逆育种和现代农业发展提供了重要的理论基础与全新的基因靶点。入选国家级青年人才项目，主持国家自然科学基金青年基金，担任多个国际期刊副编委。他在报告中与同学们分享了在科研工具快速迭代的时代，如何坚守科学判断力这一研究者的立身之本。
blocks.en: Subsequently, Professor Liang Yuanke made a presentation entitled "Tools are changing, judgement remains unchanged". Dr. Liang Yuanke, professor, doctoral supervisor, worked in the School of Life Sciences and Agriculture and Forestry of Southwestern University of Science and Technology, and graduated from the University of Ghent in Belgium. He has successively engaged in postdoctoral research at leading institutions such as the University of Geneva in Switzerland and the Mapu Institute in Germany. With a long-term focus on plant stress response and regeneration mechanisms, CRISPR gene editing and multi-omics technology have been used to systematically elucidate the molecular pathways of ERF transcription factors driving efficient regeneration after plant damage, and identify new UV-B light signal responses and protective metabolites. The first author has published several papers in leading international journals such as Science Advances, and his research has provided an important theoretical basis and new genetic targets for crop stress resistance breeding and modern agricultural development. Selected for the National Young Talent Program, presided over the National Natural Science Foundation Youth Fund, and served as a deputy editorial board member of several international journals. In the report, he shared with his classmates how to adhere to the foundation of scientific judgment in the era of rapid iteration of scientific research tools.

blocks.zh: 互动环节中，现场同学踊跃提问，两位报告人逐一细致解答。讲坛在热烈的掌声中圆满结束。
blocks.en: During the interactive session, the classmates on the scene were enthusiastic about asking questions, and the two presenters gave detailed answers one by one. The podium ended with loud applause.

blocks.zh: 本次讲坛内容贴近科研一线，兼具方法与实操，为同学们在新学期伊始审视自己的科研工作方式、善用新工具提升研究效率提供了切实参考。
blocks.en: The content of this forum is close to the front line of scientific research, and it has both methods and practices, which provides practical reference for students to review their own scientific research work methods at the beginning of the new semester and make good use of new tools to improve research efficiency.

news.titleZh: 【学术交流】山东大学李磊博士后到访 i‑Microbiome Lab 开展前沿学术报告
news.titleEn: [Academic Exchange] Postdoctoral visit by Li Lei of Shandong University to i ‑ Microbiome Lab to carry out cutting-edge academic reports

blocks.zh: 2026 年 9 月 21 日晚 20:00，应梁元可教授i‑Microbiome Lab课题组邀请，山东大学李磊博士后于东 9B2‑45 会议室作专题学术报告，实验室及院内多名师生到场参会。
blocks.en: At 20:00 on the evening of September 21, 2026, at the invitation of Professor Liang Yuanke's * * i ‑ Microbiome Lab * * research group, Dr. Li Lei of Shandong University gave a special academic report in East 9B2 ‑ 45 Conference Room, and a number of teachers and students from the laboratory and the hospital attended the meeting.

blocks.zh: 报告中，李磊博士后围绕大豆空间转录组的前沿探索工作展开汇报，系统阐述该技术在大豆研究中的实验方案、原位基因表达解析策略以及组学大数据挖掘思路，深入剖析当前研究存在的技术瓶颈与可行优化路径。依托自身科研实践经验，他进一步分享人工智能在生命科学研究中的高阶应用方案，结合组学数据处理、科研假说构建等实际场景介绍落地方法，为参会师生带来跨学科研究的新思路。
blocks.en: In the report, Dr. Li Lei reported on the cutting-edge exploration work of the soybean spatial transcriptome, systematically expounded the experimental scheme, in situ gene expression analysis strategy and big data mining ideas of the technology in soybean research, and deeply analyzed the technical bottlenecks and feasible optimization pathways of the current research. Relying on his own practical experience in scientific research, he further shared the high-level application program of artificial intelligence in life science research, combined with the introduction of landing methods in practical scenarios such as oncology data processing and scientific research hypothesis construction, and brought new ideas for interdisciplinary research to the participating teachers and students.

blocks.zh: 在交流研讨环节，与会师生就空间转录组样本前处理、测序数据分析流程、AI 科研工具选型与参数调试等问题同报告人展开充分讨论，现场研讨氛围热烈。
blocks.en: During the exchange and discussion session, the teachers and students had a full discussion with the presenter on issues such as spatial transcriptome sample pretreatment, sequencing data analysis process, AI scientific research tool selection and parameter debugging, and the on-site discussion was enthusiastic.

blocks.zh: 本次学术交流打通了校际科研沟通渠道，将前沿空间组学技术与 AI 辅助科研理念引入课题组，拓宽了团队成员的研究视野，为后续微生物组、多组学交叉方向的课题布局提供了新的切入点，对推动实验室科研方法创新、培育交叉型科研思维具有积极长远意义。
blocks.en: This academic exchange has opened up intercollegiate scientific research communication channels, introduced cutting-edge space genomics technology and AI-assisted scientific research concepts into the research group, broadened the research horizons of team members, provided a new entry point for the follow-up microbiome and multi-omics cross-directional topic layout, and has positive long-term significance for promoting laboratory scientific research method innovation and fostering cross-disciplinary scientific research thinking.

news.titleZh: 【科研进展】i‑Microbiome Lab 发表首篇 SCI 综述：梳理蚯蚓堆肥促氮效应的基质—微生物研究
news.titleEn: [Scientific progress] i ‑ Microbiome Lab published the first SCI review: Combing the matrix of nitrogen-promoting effects of earthworm compost — microbial research

blocks.zh: 近日，i‑Microbiome Lab（智能微生态与生物制造实验室）一篇综述论文在线发表于国际期刊 Frontiers in Plant Science（Sec. Plant Symbiotic Interactions）。这是该实验室组建以来的首篇 SCI 综述。
blocks.en: Recently, a review paper from the i ‑ Microbiome Lab was published online in the international journal Frontiers in Plant Science (Sec. Plant Symbiotic Interactions). This is the first SCI review since the establishment of the laboratory.

blocks.caption: 本视频为论文内容讲解，配合全文阅读使用。
blocks.captionEn: This video walks through the paper's content; best viewed together with the full text.

blocks.zh: 论文题为 Deciphering the Nitrogen‑Promoting Effect of Vermicompost: From a Complex Organic Matrix to Synthetic Microbial Communities。2026 级生物学硕士研究生李杨飞（西南科技大学生命科学与农林学院、i‑Microbiome Lab）为第一作者，黄晶教授（西南科技大学生命科学与农林学院院长）参与本项研究，梁元可教授（西南科技大学生命科学与农林学院、i‑Microbiome Lab 实验室负责人）担任通讯作者。研究由西南科技大学高层次科研人员启动基金资助。
blocks.en: The paper is entitled Deciphering the Nitrogen ‑ Promoting Effect of Vermicompost: From a Complex Organic Matrix to Synthetic Microbial Communities. Yang Fei Li, Master of Biology 2026 (i ‑ Microbiome Lab, School of Life Sciences and Agroforestry, Southwestern University of Science and Technology) is the lead author, Professor Huang Jing (Dean, School of Life Sciences and Agroforestry, Southwestern University of Science and Technology) is involved in the study, and Professor Liang Yuanke (Head of i ‑ Microbiome Lab, School of Life Sciences and Agroforestry, Southwestern University of Science and Technology) is the corresponding author. The research is funded by the Southwest University of Science and Technology's high-level research staff start-up fund.

blocks.zh: i‑Microbiome Lab 聚焦微生物组与生物制造交叉方向，围绕农业微生物资源挖掘、功能菌群设计与田间应用开展研究。本项工作是实验室组建初期对相关研究方向的一次文献整理。
blocks.en: i ‑ Microbiome Lab focuses on the intersection of the microbiome and biomanufacturing, and conducts research on agricultural microbial resource mining, functional flora design, and field applications. This work is a literature compilation of relevant research directions in the early stage of laboratory establishment.

blocks.zh: 一、研究背景与综述立项意义
blocks.en: I. Research Background and Summary Project Significance

blocks.zh: 我国农业生产中长期存在化学氮肥过量投入、作物氮素利用效率偏低的问题。田间观测显示，单施化学氮肥时约 30%–50% 的氮素被作物吸收，其余经淋溶、氨挥发、反硝化等途径损失，既造成资源浪费，也带来环境压力。
blocks.en: There are problems of excessive input of chemical nitrogen fertilizer and low nitrogen utilization efficiency of crops in agricultural production in China for a long time. Field observations show that about 30% –50% of nitrogen is absorbed by crops when chemical nitrogen fertilizer is applied alone, and the rest is lost through leaching, ammonia volatilization, denitrification, etc., resulting in waste of resources and environmental pressure.

blocks.zh: 蚯蚓堆肥由有机废弃物经蚯蚓与微生物协同转化形成，已有大量盆栽与田间试验观察到其在改良土壤、辅助作物氮素获取方面的作用。但既往研究大多只报告“施用后产量如何”，对于促氮作用究竟来自堆肥中的有机质，还是其中的微生物，以及二者如何配合，一直缺少集中的讨论。这篇综述即在广泛阅读已有文献的基础上，尝试把分散的观察组织到同一个视角下。
blocks.en: Earthworm compost is formed by the synergistic transformation of organic waste by earthworms and microorganisms. A large number of potted plants and field experiments have observed its role in improving soil and auxiliary crop nitrogen acquisition. However, most previous studies have only reported "what is the yield after application". There has been a lack of focused discussion on whether the nitrogen-promoting effect comes from the organic matter in the compost, the microorganisms in it, and how the two cooperate. This review is an attempt to organize scattered observations into the same perspective based on extensive reading of existing literature.

blocks.zh: 二、蚯蚓堆肥对作物氮素吸收的整体调控效应
blocks.en: II. Overall Regulatory Effect of Earthworm Compost on Crop Nitrogen Absorption

blocks.zh: 综述首先汇总已有文献中关于蚯蚓堆肥施用后作物与土壤变化的报道。施用蚯蚓堆肥可提升土壤总氮与有效氮库容，富集氮循环相关微生物，改变根际群落结构；在根构型与共生表型方面，已有报道观察到蚯蚓堆肥促进侧根与根毛增殖、增强豌豆根瘤与菌根真菌定殖、配施丛枝菌根（AM）真菌促进柠檬草生长等现象（原文表 1）。作者同时指出，此类结果多为表型记录，直接机制证据有限。
blocks.en: The review first summarizes the existing literature reports on crop and soil changes after the application of earthworm compost. The application of earthworm compost can enhance the total nitrogen and effective nitrogen storage capacity of the soil, enrich the microorganisms related to the nitrogen cycle, and change the rhizosphere community structure. In terms of root configuration and symbiotic phenotype, it has been reported that earthworm compost promotes the proliferation of lateral roots and root hairs, enhances the colonization of pea root nodules and mycorrhizal fungi, and combines the application of arbuscular mycorrhizal (AM) fungi to promote the growth of lemongrass (Table 1 of the original text). At the same time, the authors point out that most of these results are phenotypic records, and the direct mechanism evidence is limited.

blocks.zh: 图 1 综合已有文献结果，示意了堆肥相关微生物驱动根际氮矿化后，作物如何经 AMT（铵转运蛋白）、NRT（硝酸盐转运蛋白）吸收氮素，并经 GS‑GOGAT 途径完成胞内同化。
blocks.en: Figure 1 shows how crops absorb nitrogen through Amt (ammonium transporter) and NRT (nitrate transporter) after compost-related microorganisms drive rhizospheric nitrogen mineralization, and complete intracellular assimilation through the GS ‑ GOGAT pathway.

blocks.zh: （图 1 蚯蚓堆肥介导作物根系氮素获取的可能途径，包括微生物驱动根际氮矿化、AMT/NRT 转运蛋白吸收与 GS‑GOGAT 胞内同化。来源：Li et al., Front. Plant Sci., 2026，CC‑BY 4.0）
blocks.en: (Figure 1 Possible pathways for crop root nitrogen capture mediated by earthworm compost include microbial-driven rhizospheric nitrogen mineralization, Amt/NRT transporter uptake, and GS ‑ GOGAT intracellular assimilation. Source: Li et al., Front. Plant Sci., 2026, CC ‑ BY 4.0)

blocks.zh: 三、不同施肥模式的氮素分配特征与田间表现
blocks.en: III. Nitrogen distribution characteristics and field performance of different fertilization modes

blocks.zh:
综述汇总了已发表的施肥模式对比研究。不同作者在不同条件下的结果可以归纳为以下几点：

  1. 单施化学氮肥。多数报道显示氮素环境损失比例较高。

  2. 单施蚯蚓堆肥。多数报道显示供氮平缓、损失较低，但速效供氮能力有限。

  3. 化肥配施蚯蚓堆肥。已有报道显示，在部分条件下可以同时获得较平稳的供氮和较低的损失。
blocks.en: The review summarizes published comparative studies of fertilization patterns. The results of different authors under different conditions can be summarized as follows: single application of chemical nitrogen fertilizer. Most reports indicate a high proportion of nitrogen environmental losses. Apply earthworm compost alone. Most reports show that the nitrogen supply is moderate and the loss is low, but the quick-acting nitrogen supply capacity is limited. Fertilizer is combined with earthworm compost. It has been reported that a smoother nitrogen supply and lower losses can be obtained at the same time under some conditions.

blocks.zh: 图 2 对已有文献中三种模式的氮素分配作了示意性比较。
blocks.en: Figure 2 shows a schematic comparison of the three modes of nitrogen allocation in the existing literature.

blocks.zh: （图 2 三种施肥模式下土壤氮素分配与环境损失对比（据已有文献归纳示意）。来源：Li et al., Front. Plant Sci., 2026，CC‑BY 4.0）
blocks.en: (Figure 2 Comparison of soil nitrogen allocation and environmental loss under the three fertilization modes (according to the existing literature). Source: Li et al., Front. Plant Sci., 2026, CC ‑ BY 4.0)

blocks.zh: 已有田间试验提供了具体证据。在减施矿质氮的条件下配施蚯蚓堆肥，玉米产量可维持全量化肥水平，植株总氮吸收量达到 112.6 kg/ha；在辣椒、豆类和谷物上也观察到类似的正向趋势，例如辣椒上相对农户习惯施肥，氮磷钾积累量提高 17%–58%。作者强调，这些结果受作物、土壤和管理条件影响，不能简单外推。
blocks.en: Field trials have provided concrete evidence. With the application of earthworm compost under the condition of mineral nitrogen reduction, the yield of maize can maintain the level of full chemical fertilizer, and the total nitrogen absorption of plants reaches 112.6 kg/ha. Similar positive trends have been observed in peppers, legumes, and grains. For example, the accumulation of nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium on peppers increased by 17% –58% compared with the customary fertilization of farmers. The authors emphasize that these results are influenced by crop, soil, and management conditions and cannot be simply extrapolated.

blocks.zh: 四、基质与微生物协同促氮机制解析
blocks.en: IV. Analysis of the synergistic nitrogen-promoting mechanism between matrix and microorganisms

blocks.zh: 在现象观察的基础上，综述尝试从“基质”和“微生物”两个维度理解上述效应。这是综述在归纳已有文献后提出的一个组织视角，并非新的实验结论。
blocks.en: On the basis of phenomenon observation, the review attempts to understand the above effects from the two dimensions of "matrix" and "microorganism". This is an organizational perspective proposed after reviewing the existing literature, and is not a new experimental conclusion.

blocks.zh:
（一）关于基质的作用。 综合已有报道，有机质基质在三方面被反复提及。

  1. 养分缓释。腐殖胶体结合有机氮，在土壤中缓慢矿化，避免一次性释放造成流失。

  2. 保氮固持。腐殖胶体带负电荷，通过阳离子交换吸附铵离子，减少氮随水淋失。

  3. 提供微生境。腐殖质为微生物提供碳源和栖息空间，被认为是微生物在堆肥和土壤中定居繁殖的重要条件。
blocks.en: (1) About the role of the matrix. Taken together, it has been reported that the organic matrix has been repeatedly mentioned in three aspects. Slow release of nutrients. Humus colloids combine with organic nitrogen to slowly mineralize in the soil and avoid loss due to one-time release. Nitrogen retention. Humus colloids are negatively charged, and ammonium ions are adsorbed by cation exchange to reduce nitrogen leaching with water. Provides microhabitats. Humus provides a carbon source and habitat for microorganisms, and is considered an important condition for microorganisms to settle and reproduce in compost and soil.

blocks.zh:
（二）关于微生物的来源。 关于堆肥中功能微生物从何而来，已有研究主要提出两条富集途径。

  1. 体内途径（蚯蚓肠道）。蚯蚓取食有机物料时，肠道对微生物进行选择性筛选和富集，耐逆、促生菌株随蚓粪排出。

  2. 体外途径（蚓触圈）。堆肥施入土壤后，蚯蚓活动形成的蚓触圈（drilosphere，即蚯蚓活动形成的特殊微环境）不同于周围原土，其中的黏附物质、养分梯度和 pH 条件被认为会激活土壤中原本休眠的土著微生物，包括与氮循环相关的类群。
blocks.en: (2) Sources of microorganisms. Regarding the origin of functional microorganisms in compost, two enrichment pathways have been proposed. In vivo pathway (earthworm intestine). When earthworms feed on organic materials, the intestines selectively screen and enrich microorganisms, and stress-resistant and growth-promoting strains are excreted with vermicompost. Extracorporeal pathways (worm antennae). After the compost is applied to the soil, the drilosphere (the special microenvironment formed by earthworm activity) formed by earthworm activity is different from the surrounding original soil, and the adhesion substances, nutrient gradients, and pH conditions are thought to activate the dormant indigenous microorganisms in the soil, including the groups related to the nitrogen cycle.

blocks.zh:
（三）关于微生物的作用。 综合已有研究，堆肥相关微生物对作物氮获取的影响可归为直接和间接两类。

  1. 直接作用。已有报道记录了微生物参与有机氮矿化、生物固氮、硝化等氮素形态转化过程，被认为直接改变根际有效氮库。

  2. 间接作用。部分文献提示，微生物可能通过分泌植物激素或信号分子，影响作物根系构型，并与氮转运相关基因（AMT、NRT 家族）的表达变化相关。作者同时指出，这一间接通路在蚯蚓堆肥体系中的直接实验证据仍有限，现有讨论多参照一般植物—微生物互作体系。
blocks.en: (3) Regarding the role of microorganisms. Combined with existing studies, the effects of compost-related microorganisms on crop nitrogen access can be classified into two categories: direct and indirect. Direct action. Microorganisms have been reported to participate in the transformation of nitrogen forms such as organic nitrogen mineralization, biological nitrogen fixation, and nitrification, which is considered to directly change the rhizosphere effective nitrogen pool. Indirect action. Some literature suggests that microorganisms may affect crop root configuration by secreting plant hormones or signaling molecules and are associated with changes in the expression of nitrogen transport-related genes (Amt, NRT family). The authors also pointed out that the direct experimental evidence of this indirect pathway in the earthworm composting system is still limited, and the existing discussions refer to the general plant-microbial interaction system.

blocks.zh: 图 3 集中展示了上述两条富集途径、直接与间接作用通路，以及最终汇入根际有效氮库的过程。
blocks.en: Figure 3 shows the above two enrichment pathways, direct and indirect action pathways, and finally the process of sinking into the rhizospheric effective nitrogen reservoir.

blocks.zh: （图 3 蚯蚓堆肥微生物介导氮转化过程示意图，包括蚯蚓肠道体内筛选、蚓触圈体外激活两条富集途径，以及直接氮转化与间接调控植物氮获取的通路。图件由 BioGDP.com 绘制。来源：Li et al., Front. Plant Sci., 2026，CC‑BY 4.0）
blocks.en: (Figure 3 Schematic diagram of the microbial-mediated nitrogen conversion process of earthworm compost, including in vivo screening of earthworm intestines, in vitro activation of worm contact rings, and direct nitrogen conversion and indirect regulation of plant nitrogen acquisition. The image is drawn by BioGDP.com. Source: Li et al., Front. Plant Sci., 2026, CC ‑ BY 4.0)

blocks.zh: （四）两个维度之间的关系。 在归纳上述文献的基础上，作者提出，基质和微生物在时间上可能存在先后衔接。基质先行构建物质与环境条件，包括提供碳源、固定铵离子、营造微生境；微生物在此基础上参与氮素转化和对作物的信号影响。作者尝试用“基质启动、微生物放大”来概括这一关系。
blocks.en: (4) The relationship between the two dimensions. On the basis of summarizing the above literature, the authors suggest that there may be a temporal connection between the matrix and microorganisms. The substrate first builds material and environmental conditions, including providing a carbon source, fixing ammonium ions, and creating microhabitats; on this basis, microorganisms are involved in nitrogen conversion and signal influence on crops. The authors attempted to summarize this relationship with “matrix initiation, microbial amplification”.

blocks.zh: 五、应用价值与产品质控体系讨论
blocks.en: V. Discussion on application value and product quality control system

blocks.zh: 在文献归纳的基础上，综述进一步讨论了上述认识在产品研发和生产中的可能含义。
blocks.en: On the basis of the literature summary, the review further discusses the possible implications of the above knowledge in product development and production.

blocks.zh: （一）合成微生物群落的思路。 已有研究普遍观察到，单一菌株施入大田后环境适应性弱、功能不稳定。综述据此讨论了从蚯蚓堆肥中筛选氮循环功能菌株，并按模块化设计与功能冗余原则组装合成微生物群落（SynCom）的思路，认为这可能为提升菌群田间稳定性提供一条路径。
blocks.en: (1) Ideas for synthetic microbial communities. It has been generally observed in previous studies that a single strain has weak environmental adaptability and unstable function after being applied to the field. Based on this review, we discussed the idea of screening functional strains of nitrogen cycle from earthworm compost and assembling synthetic microbial communities (SynCom) according to the principles of modular design and functional redundancy, which may provide a pathway to improve the stability of microbial communities in the field.

blocks.zh: （二）产品质量控制参数。 综述梳理蚯蚓堆肥从原料预处理、受控发酵到成品检测全流程，在原文表 2 中归纳出涵盖化学、生物、物理三类的质控参考框架。作者指出，对比国内外现有标准，当前规范大多聚焦养分、重金属等理化安全指标，针对蚯蚓堆肥生物促氮能力的功能评价，尚未建立统一、可量化的指标体系，这是制约蚯蚓堆肥产品规范化应用的关键瓶颈。
blocks.en: (2) Product quality control parameters. Summarize the entire process of combing earthworm compost from raw material pretreatment, controlled fermentation to finished product testing, and summarize the quality control reference framework covering chemical, biological, and physical categories in Table 2 of the original text. The author points out that compared with existing standards at home and abroad, the current norms mostly focus on physical and chemical safety indicators such as nutrients and heavy metals. For the functional evaluation of the biological nitrogen-promoting capacity of earthworm composting, a unified and quantifiable index system has not yet been established, which is a key bottleneck restricting the standardized application of earthworm composting products.

blocks.zh: （三）田间效果的综合观察。 原文表 3 汇总了多类作物盆栽与田间试验的已有报道。已有文献观察到，配施蚯蚓堆肥有助于改善作物产量、氮素利用效率与土壤健康状态，具备经济、环境与生态层面的综合效益。作者同时指出，效益幅度受土壤、作物和管理条件调节。
blocks.en: (3) Comprehensive observation of field effects. Table 3 of the original article summarizes the existing reports on potting and field trials of various crops. It has been observed in the literature that the application of earthworm compost helps to improve crop yield, nitrogen utilization efficiency and soil health, and has comprehensive economic, environmental and ecological benefits. At the same time, the authors point out that benefit margins are regulated by soil, crops, and management conditions.

blocks.zh: 六、领域研究短板与未来研究方向
blocks.en: VI. Field research shortcomings and future research directions

blocks.zh:
基于文献梳理，论文归纳出当前该领域尚存的若干关键科学短板。

  1. 定量问题。基质与微生物各自对促氮效应的贡献比例，目前缺少标准化的解析方法。

  2. 定殖问题。功能菌株施入田间后的原位定殖和种群演变规律，已有研究仍不充分。

  3. 标准问题。产品层面的生物促氮功能评价指标，目前缺失。

  4. 互作问题。蚯蚓堆肥与植物根际共生微生物之间的互作，直接实验证据仍有限。

这些问题也是 i‑Microbiome Lab 后续研究计划准备回应的方向。
blocks.en: Based on the literature, the paper summarizes some key scientific shortcomings in this field. Quantitative issues. The ratio of the contribution of the substrate to the microorganism to the nitrogen-promoting effect, and the lack of standardized analytical methods. Colonization problem. The in-situ colonization and population evolution of functional strains after application to the field are still insufficiently studied. Standard question. Evaluation indicator of biological nitrogen-promoting function at the product level, currently missing. Interaction problem. Direct experimental evidence of interaction between earthworm compost and symbiotic microorganisms in the rhizosphere of plants is still limited. These questions are also the direction in which i ‑ Microbiome Lab's follow-up study plan is prepared to respond.

blocks.zh: 结语
blocks.en: Conclusion

blocks.zh: 作为一篇叙述性综述，这篇文章本身不报告新的实验数据，而是在阅读和整理已有文献的基础上，尝试提供一个把“基质—微生物—作物”放在一起理解的角度。它的价值在于把过去分散的观察组织到同一框架下，并把现有研究的空白点明确指出来，供后续试验设计参考。后续 i‑Microbiome Lab 将围绕文中提到的若干未决问题开展工作。
blocks.en: As a narrative review, the article itself does not report new experimental data, but rather attempts to provide a perspective that puts “matrix-microorganism-crop” together on the basis of reading and collating existing literature. Its value lies in organizing the scattered observations of the past under the same framework, and clearly pointing out the gaps in the existing research for reference in the subsequent trial design. Subsequently, the i ‑ Microbiome Lab will work on a number of the outstanding issues mentioned in this article.

news.titleZh: 【学术交流】广州大学张淼博士应邀为i‑Microbiome Lab作线上学术报告
news.titleEn: [Academic Exchange] Dr. Zhang Miao of Guangzhou University was invited to give an online academic report for i ‑ Microbiome Lab

blocks.zh: 近日，为进一步拓宽科研视野、促进作物分子遗传与逆境生物学方向的学术交流，梁元可教授领衔的i‑Microbiome Lab通过腾讯会议线上平台，邀请广州大学张淼博士开展专题学术报告，课题组全体师生参会学习。
blocks.en: Recently, in order to further broaden the horizon of scientific research and promote academic exchanges in the direction of crop molecular genetics and adversity biology, Professor Liang Yuanke's i ‑ Microbiome Lab invited Dr. Zhang Miao of Guangzhou University to carry out special academic reports through the Tencent Conference online platform, and all teachers and students in the research group participated in the study.

blocks.zh: 张淼博士现为广州大学创新分子遗传与进化中心博士后研究员，2024年6月获哈尔滨师范大学遗传学博士学位，主要从事作物耐盐、耐重金属胁迫分子调控机制研究。目前以第一作者发表SCI论文3篇，授权国家发明专利1项，主持广州地区联合基金项目1项，熟练掌握作物遗传转化、CRISPR基因编辑、多组学分析及转录调控验证等关键技术体系。
blocks.en: Dr. Zhang Miao is currently a postdoctoral researcher at the Innovative Molecular Genetics and Evolution Center of Guangzhou University. In June 2024, he obtained a doctorate in genetics from Harbin Normal University. He is mainly engaged in the study of molecular regulation mechanisms of crop salt tolerance and heavy metal tolerance. At present, the first author has published 3 SCI papers, authorized 1 national invention patent, presided over 1 joint fund project in Guangzhou, and is proficient in key technology systems such as crop genetic transformation, CRISPR gene editing, multi-omics analysis, and transcriptional regulation verification.

blocks.zh: 报告中，张淼博士系统介绍了其近期代表性研究成果。在博士后研究阶段，团队聚焦大豆光周期转录因子E1，揭示其通过直接抑制GmCIPK25表达、负调控大豆耐盐性的分子机制，相关成果已投稿至《Journal of Genetics and Genomics》。
blocks.en: In the report, Dr. Zhang Miao systematically introduced his recent representative research results. In the postdoctoral research phase, the team focused on soybean photoperiod transcription factor E1 to reveal its molecular mechanism of direct inhibition of GmCIPK25 expression and negative regulation of soybean salt tolerance. The relevant results have been submitted to the Journal of Genetics and Genomics.

blocks.zh: 报告结束后，师生围绕作物抗逆基因挖掘、转录调控机制、多组学数据分析与基因编辑技术应用等问题展开深入交流，讨论氛围浓厚，有效促进了学科思路互通与技术经验共享。
blocks.en: After the report, teachers and students conducted in-depth exchanges on issues such as crop stress resistance gene mining, transcriptional regulation mechanisms, multi-omics data analysis, and gene editing technology applications. The atmosphere of discussion was strong, which effectively promoted the exchange of disciplinary ideas and the sharing of technical experience.

blocks.zh: 本次线上学术交流内容前沿、成果扎实，有效拓宽了课题组在作物逆境分子生物学领域的研究视野，为实验室开展作物抗性调控、微生物—作物互作等相关交叉研究提供了新思路与新方法，对推动团队科研创新与学术发展具有积极促进作用。
blocks.en: The content of this online academic exchange is cutting-edge and the results are solid, which effectively broadens the research field of the research group in the field of crop stress molecular biology. It provides new ideas and new methods for the laboratory to carry out cross-cutting research such as crop resistance regulation and microbial-crop interaction, and has a positive role in promoting team scientific research innovation and academic development.

partners.introEn: We partner with enterprises and research institutions worldwide to bring microbiome science from the lab into industry and frontier discovery. Lit regions on the map mark where we collaborate.

items.nameZh: 上海春露生物化学有限公司
items.descZh: 始创于1996年，位于上海嘉定，专注羧甲基壳聚糖（CM-chitosan）等生物化学原料的研发与产业化，拥有5项国家发明专利，并作为核心起草单位牵头制定《化妆品用原料 羧甲基脱乙酰壳多糖》团体标准。双方围绕壳聚糖基生物刺激素与农业微生物菌剂的协同开发开展合作。
items.descEn: Founded in 1996 and based in Shanghai's Jiading District, Chunlu specializes in carboxymethyl chitosan and biochemical raw materials, holding 5 national invention patents and leading the industry group standard for CM-chitosan. Collaboration focuses on chitosan-based biostimulants synergized with agricultural microbial agents.

items.nameZh: 四川禾创种业有限公司
items.descZh: 成立于2017年，位于四川绵阳游仙区，国家级科技型中小企业、市级农业产业化重点龙头企业，持有农作物种子生产经营许可证，自育玉米/油菜/小麦等良种20余个，主推高蛋白玉米'禾创599'（高蛋白、无穗腐）。双方围绕高蛋白玉米与微生物合成群落（SynCom）促氮的联合选育与田间示范开展合作。
items.descEn: Founded in 2017 in Mianyang, Sichuan, a national high-tech SME and municipal leading agricultural enterprise with a seed production license. It has developed 20+ proprietary crop varieties including the high-protein maize 'Hechuang 599'. Collaboration focuses on joint breeding and field demonstration of high-protein maize with microbiome SynCom for nitrogen promotion.

items.nameZh: 绵阳晟氏健康科技有限公司
items.nameEn: Mianyang Shengshi Health Technology Co., Ltd.
items.descZh: 成立于2020年，基地位于绵阳北川合成生物产业园，国家高新技术企业、四川省瞪羚企业，拥有合成生物学体系GMP生产线与原料药生产许可证，专注手性氨基酸、功能食品原料与抗衰因子，产品出口海内外。双方围绕微生物资源挖掘与功能食品原料的联合研发与生产开展合作。
items.descEn: Founded in 2020 with a base in the Mianyang Beichuan synthetic-biology industrial park, Shengshi is a national high-tech enterprise and Sichuan gazelle firm, operating GMP lines and an API license, focused on chiral amino acids and functional-food ingredients. Collaboration targets joint R&D and production on microbial resources and functional-food raw materials.

items.descZh: 东非以小规模玉米种植为主的农业国。双方围绕土壤健康与蚯蚓粪源微生物菌剂、以及高蛋白玉米在非洲小农体系的适应性，开展国际合作与田间示范，服务小农增产与粮食安全。
items.descEn: An East African agriculture-based nation centered on smallholder maize. Collaboration focuses on soil health, earthworm-cast microbial agents, and the adaptation of high-protein maize for smallholder systems to support yield gains and food security.

items.nameZh: 德国马克斯·普朗克学会
items.descZh: 与德国马克斯·普朗克学会（Max Planck Society）相关研究所开展前沿微生物学与合成生物学学术交流，聚焦植物-微生物互作、微生物组机制与人工合成群落的前沿探索。
items.descEn: Academic exchange with institutes of the Max Planck Society on frontier microbiology and synthetic biology, focusing on plant–microbe interactions, microbiome mechanisms, and synthetic community exploration.

items.descZh: 比利时在植物生物技术与根际微生物组领域研究实力雄厚（如根际微生物互作前沿团队）。双方围绕根际促生微生物与作物氮素高效利用开展国际合作与交流。
items.descEn: Belgium is a powerhouse in plant biotechnology and rhizosphere microbiome. Collaboration focuses on plant-growth-promoting microbes and nitrogen-use efficiency in crops.

items.descZh: 瑞士在微生物生态与微生物组学领域国际领先（如苏黎世联邦理工等）。双方围绕微生物组功能解析与合成群落（SynCom）构建开展学术交流与合作。
items.descEn: Switzerland leads in microbial ecology and microbiome science. Collaboration focuses on microbiome functional analysis and synthetic community (SynCom) construction.

items.descZh: 巴基斯坦农业微生物与根际促生菌（PGPR）研究活跃。双方围绕促生微生物资源挖掘与抗旱、低氮条件下作物促生机制开展国际合作。
items.descEn: Pakistan has active research in agricultural microbiology and plant-growth-promoting rhizobacteria (PGPR). Collaboration targets growth-promoting microbial resources and mechanisms under drought and low-nitrogen conditions.

software.summaryZh: 量微（Liangwei）是面向照片与显微图像的定量测量桌面软件，由付诸教育咨询工作室与智能微生态与生物制造实验室联合开发维护。
software.summaryEn: Liangwei is a desktop image-measurement tool for photographs and microscopy images, jointly developed and maintained by Fuzhu Education Consulting Studio and the Laboratory of Intelligent Microbiome and Biomanufacturing.
software.descZh: 量微（Liangwei）由付诸教育咨询工作室与智能微生态与生物制造实验室联合开发维护。面向照片与显微图像，提供比例尺标定、长度测量（直线/曲线）、面积与形态参数、阈值分割与颗粒分析、灰度直方图等定量测量功能，测量结果可编辑并导出 CSV。全部在本地完成，图像数据不出本机。
software.descEn: Liangwei is jointly developed and maintained by Fuzhu Education Consulting Studio and the Laboratory of Intelligent Microbiome and Biomanufacturing. Built for photographs and microscopy images, it offers scale calibration, length measurement (straight/curved lines), area and shape parameters, threshold segmentation and particle analysis, and grayscale histograms. Measurement results are editable and exportable to CSV. All processing runs locally — image data never leaves the machine.
